prose.text: The chunk's own entries come first, then the standard gate set in test-plan §3 order. `capability-drift` precedes the default-features workspace nextest. The `--features mcp-server` regen and the base-identity bindings close come last, since no procedure is added. The live legs and the operator pass follow.

The GREEN end-to-end leg boots the real binary anyway. - No Rust dependency is added, which the scope guard asserts (`Cargo.lock` / `Cargo.toml` excluded from its allow list).   The one third-party file is the vendored Python converter, which cargo-deny cannot see. Its MIT provenance is recorded   beside it (step 2) and asserted by an entry. CI's `supply-chain` job runs `cargo deny` / `cargo audit`, and the CI read   asserts it. - No headful self-verify: no UI change.

The boot is the operator's, so no entry starts the app. The RED-leg reads run once, on the chunk-base build, before step 2. The GREEN reads run on the rebuilt tree.

Its precondition is the operator slot entry before it, ports free and no `llama-cli`   resident, so no `round` probe precedes it.
